hook: Evan Solomon is Canada's Minister of Artificial Intelligence and Digital Innovation, named when Prime Minister Mark Carney announced his ministry on 13 May 2025. He is also responsible for the Federal Economic Development Agency for Southern Ontario. As minister he signed Canada's AI declaration and Sovereign Technology Alliance with Germany in February 2026, and he presented the national strategy AI for All in June 2026.
